# Scopes and linking

## Description

The modifiers `IDENTIFIES` and `REFERS TO` link independent projects:
one project declares who an entity is, another refers to it. Not every
scope accepts them.

## Syntax

```synesis
FIELD <name> TYPE <type>
    SCOPE SOURCE
    [IDENTIFIES <entity>]
    [REFERS TO <entity>]
END FIELD
```

`[ ]` optional · `<>` value to replace

## Rules

| Scope | `IDENTIFIES` | `REFERS TO` |
|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | Allowed | Allowed |
| `ITEM` | Forbidden (SYNESIS_E078) | Forbidden (SYNESIS_E078) |
| `ONTOLOGY` | Forbidden (SYNESIS_E078) | Forbidden (SYNESIS_E078) |
